'''Old Gloxix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[styanax]]&mdash;a [[Species/Legends|species]] of aquatic predator&mdash;that dwelled in the seas of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]]. 14 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, Old Gloxix was scarred and stingerless, and he had a black-colored hide. In [[496 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> he was [[Death/Legends|brought down]] by the [[stabmen]] crews of three [[nagak]] canoes, and veteran stabmen later told tales of the hunt for Old Gloxix.
